name: Argentine Lake District
about: Summer (Dec–Feb) is best for lake hiking and the Seven Lakes road trip; winter (Jun–Aug) turns Bariloche into South America's biggest ski destination, centered on Cerro Catedral.
overview: Alpine lakes, Swiss-chalet architecture, and chocolate shops around Bariloche — northern Argentine Patagonia's one region with real ski infrastructure.
costOverview: Ski season and peak summer both push prices up, with lift tickets and lake-circuit tours as the real cost drivers.
monthlyWeather: peak summer, mild and one of the best months for the Seven Lakes road trip
